_comment: Run 20261007 through the water-filled acrylic tube: T0 = wand calibration, Planes = the 30 Sep dot board at three stage positions, T1 = tracers. Lengths in mm, image coordinates in px (u = column, v = row, pixel centres at integers). The top-level wand keys (raw_dir ... calibrate) are T0's, in the layout of the 6 Oct cases, so that their code is reused; the Planes and T1 have their own sections. See 2026-10-07-plan.md.

image.camera: Phantom VEO 710L (from the .chd headers; serials 29199 = cam1, 23752 = cam2, as on 6 Oct)

same_camera_settings: The user (7 Oct): focus and aperture were not changed between T0, the Planes and T1; the cameras share one calibration.

wand._comment: The wand of 6 Oct: 10 mm long (centre to centre), balls 3 mm and 4 mm, rod about 2 mm. End A is the small ball.

tube._comment: As on 6 Oct: OD 7.9375 in, wall 0.125 in.

detect._comment: T2's settings (6 Oct), checked on this run by the survey P0d.
detect._workers: 16 processes: the file server (about 22 MB/s) limits the speed.

accept._comment: The 6 Oct rules: a camera-frame is kept with two balls apart (the guard), both fits with an edge RMS at most edge_rms_max_px and an aspect ratio in aspect_range, and both sizes (sqrt(a b)) within size_tol of the camera's median for that ball. A frame is kept when every camera keeps it.

calibrate._comment: As on 6 Oct, but n_final 2 (the GUI's default) instead of the thorough search's 6. With 6, a start in a wrong minimum (cam1 f 10,995 px at 253 mm from the axis, cam2 7,709 px at 210 mm; RMS 1.38 px) kept 12,088 of 12,144 observations against 11,876 for the right one (RMS 0.600 px) and won calibrate's rule (most observations kept first): its larger residuals make its 5-sigma outlier limit wider. The first two starts both reach the 0.60 px minimum. That run is kept in wrong_minimum_nfinal6/ here and on X:.

tracking_camfiles._comment: C4: copies of the delivered camFiles for tracking, with the projection tolerance of the C++ default (the wand fit writes 1e-12, at which a few points in each camera's near/far junction plane get no image).

reference_T2._comment: Run T2 of 6 Oct, for the camera-move test C1-X.

reference_20260930._comment: cam1 in the dot-board case cyl_20260930_T0_cam1 (through the tube) and its focal check in air (5 Oct).

planes._comment: The 30 Sep dot board at three stage positions, one frame per camera each. README.txt: '0,1,2: Far from cam1'. The user (7 Oct): the stage moved about one full turn of its screw, about 0.125 in, between positions.
planes.direction: away from cam1 as the index grows

detect._comment: The 30 Sep case's detector settings (cases/cyl_20260930_T0_cam1/config.json), for both cameras unless detect_overrides says otherwise.

tracers._comment: T1: 60 um polyamide tracer particles (the user, 7 Oct), backlit (dark particles on a bright background). Both cameras on one trigger at 4,000 frames/s, 100 us exposure (cam2's .chd; cam1's folder has none, the user: same settings, synchronised).
